messages:
anna-tsai: Heads-up — running a simulated key-exfiltration drill tomorrow 10:00am PT. Scope: BYOK/HSM proxy only, dummy tenant, no customer data. Goal: validate RBAC emergency flows, audit collection, and external-notify playbook.
omar-khan: +1. Who's owning ops during the run? Need oncall handoff and a rollback trigger.
anna-tsai: assigning @oncall-sre for ops. rollback trigger = any failed key-rotation or unexpected key export artifact.
oncall-sre: I can own the run. I'll be on call 9:30-11:30. What exact steps?
rahul-patel: Proposed quick plan: 1) spin up edge-hsm-sim container with test key; 2) run exfiltration script that simulates Wrap/Export calls; 3) validate alerts and audit logs; 4) run forced rotation and revoke.
maria-g: Legal needs timeline for notification obligations if simulation shows a real exfil event. @legal-jordan?
legal-jordan: Since this is simulated and uses non-prod dummy tenant, no external notification is required. If we observe any customer key material or PII accidentally touched, immediately pause the drill and file an incident with Security Ops.
omar-khan: RBAC change request: temporarily restrict the "hsm-operator" group from Wrap/Export for duration of test to validate emergency escalation. Can we do a scoped policy toggle?
rahul-patel: We can apply a conditional deny in the proxy authz for WrapKey for hsm-operator for 1h. Command (example):
```
# Example: add deny rule in proxy RBAC (pseudo)
kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: proxy.redwood/v1
kind: RBACRule
metadata:
  name: deny-hsm-op-wrap-test
spec:
  subjects: ["group:hsm-operator"]
  actions: ["WrapKey","ExportKey"]
  effect: "Deny"
  expires: "2026-03-22T18:15:00Z"
EOF
```
anna-tsai: Add automated rollback to remove the deny rule if telemetry shows failing requests for other tenants.
oncall-sre: For audit queries, we'll look in both proxy logs and KMS audit logs. Sample CloudWatch/AWS config:
```
# CloudWatch filter example
aws logs filter-log-events --log-group-name /redwood/kms-proxy --filter-pattern '"action":"WrapKey"' --start-time 1679589600000 --end-time 1679593200000
```
crypto-ops-bot: Reminder: HSM vendor logs are separate — request a copy of HSM audit bundles before the test window. I've created ticket TKT-1342.
maria-g: For compliance evidence, we need: timeline of change, RBAC delta, logs (proxy/KMS/HSM), and signed attestation that no customer keys were used. Add to the drill artifact pack.
rahul-patel: Triage checklist if we see anomalous exports: 1) isolate node, 2) collect HSM audit bundle, 3) snapshot proxy container, 4) rotate affected key (or stash new key), 5) notify security + legal.
legal-jordan: Keep a play-by-play in the incident channel during the drill. If anything crosses into actual customer material, we will follow the external notification runbook.
omar-khan: Quick vuln triage note — if the exfil simulation uses a new exploit path, we may need to block the vulnerable endpoint and run smoke test. Ensure we have a canary traffic route for rollback.
oncall-sre: Ops checklist appended to the runbook: pre-checks (CU permissions, backup HSM CA certs, ensure monitoring alerts routed to PagerDuty), in-run commands (audit queries), rollback steps.
anna-tsai: I'll post the final runbook and links to tickets now. Please ack if you can attend the post-mortem 11:30am PT.
maria-g: Acknowledged. I will join.
rahul-patel: I'll run the audit queries and hand over log extraction to @crypto-ops-bot.
legal-jordan: I'll be on standby for notification decisions.
oncall-sre: sgtm. :white_check_mark:
anna-tsai: Thanks everyone — we will run the test and capture artifacts. Remember: dummy tenant only, strict scope, immediate abort if any real customer key touched.
